positionCoach.guidance: Coach from the sprint result. Motion observations are model estimates; do not present them as measured or as observed mechanics unless video evidence is reviewed.

warnings: No source video referenced; no mechanics can be observed from this assessment.
filmAnalyst.guidance: Flag capture limitations; request a calibrated or electronically timed retest before strong conclusions.

methodology: Units normalized to seconds / inches; drill mapped to a combine metric.
Percentile only for electronically timed, verified measurements vs same-position NFL Combine invitees (direction-aware).
AR-assisted, video or hand timing: descriptive band only; no validated conversion to electronic timing is applied.
No 10-yard split reference exists in the ingested sources; such results are reported as unavailable.

dataQualityExceptions.impact: Upstream nflverse weekly player stats contain rows with no player_id (GSIS). They cannot be attributed to an athlete, are kept in bronze for lineage, and are excluded from silver.nfl_qb_season_stats. Combine benchmarks and PFF data are unaffected.
